- Option B: Tue 17 Mar 16:30–17:15 UTC  (09:30 PST / 16:30 GMT / 01:30 JST next day)
- Option C: Wed 18 Mar 13:00–13:45 UTC  (06:00 PST / 13:00 GMT / 22:00 JST)

Quick notes:
- Option A aligns with late Tokyo evening (Hiro mentioned mornings are better for him, so A might not work)
- Option B is mid-late evening JST (~01:30) — also rough for APAC
- Option C is early for SF (6:00) but Hiro can do later in his day, and Emma you're in the UK so C is mid-afternoon for you.

Vivek — looping you in on availability for the exec slot.

I can send calendar invites once we lock a slot. Attaching a quick timezone conversion chart.

FWIW — for other multi-region customers we've done a 25-min exec sync scheduled to align with the US morning, then a separate ~45-min product session scheduled at an APAC-friendly time with the same recording/recap. That keeps exec time low and still gives APAC a live deep dive.

Proposed final plan if everyone agrees:
- Exec sync (Vivek + BrightRetail execs): Wed 18 Mar 13:00–13:25 UTC (06:00 PST / 13:00 GMT / 22:00 JST) — keeps Vivek for a short window and fits Emma well
- Product deep-dive (product + technical stakeholders including Hiro): Wed 18 Mar 20:00–20:45 UTC (13:00 PST / 20:00 GMT / 05:00 JST next day) — later for Hiro but possible, or we can offer a recorded session + live Q&A next morning JST.

If BrightRetail prefers a single session, we can stick with Option A or B, but I think the split is more respectful of exec calendars.

-Jonas
